data.title: Bitcoin steadies near $80,400 after weekend selloff, Fed decision looms
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin was up around $80,400 on Sunday, as it steadied after a sharp weekend selloff and investors assessed heavy cryptocurrency liquidations ahead of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest rate decision.
